description: One infinite whiteboard, stored in the author's repo. The record IS the board: its items carry their own spatial coordinates, so a board can be rendered from the record alone with no index, no server and no appview. Media lives in blobs on the same PDS; child boards are separate records of this same type, referenced by at-uri.

parent.description: The board this one was nested out of, if any. Set once at birth and left alone: it is a back-link for breadcrumbs, not an ownership claim — the parent's portal item is the authoritative edge.

camera.description: Last viewport. Reopening a board should put you where you left off; that continuity is most of what makes an infinite canvas feel like a place.
